summary: Retest of IP-validation bug-fix briefing: 6/6 acceptance criteria exercised. Full backend suite 30/30 passed (5 new tests added in test_tscheck_ip_validation.py, 25 pre-existing unchanged/passed). 4/4 browser checks passed (1 new for the IP-validation UI hints, 3 re-run persisted by name).

checks.criterion: Invalid server IP rejected with Turkish IPv4 message, never a raw Cloudflare error (backend)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ip_validation.py::test_invalid_server_ip_rejected_with_turkish_message
checks.evidence: PUT /api/cloudflare/settings {server_ip:'benim-sunucum'} -> 400 {detail: "'benim-sunucum' geçerli bir IPv4 adresi değil (örn. 203.161.57.207)"}; message contains the value + 'IPv4' and does not contain 'Content for A record'.

checks.criterion: autowire with empty saved IP returns actionable 400, never raw Cloudflare A-record error (backend)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ip_validation.py::test_autowire_with_empty_server_ip_gives_actionable_400
checks.evidence: PUT settings {server_ip:''} -> 200 confirmed empty; POST /api/cloudflare/autowire {domain:'sultan5.com'} -> 400 {detail: "Önce 'Sunucu IP adresi' alanına sunucunun IPv4 adresini kaydedin"}; no 'Content for A record'/'must be a valid IPv4 address' substring present.

checks.criterion: autowire works again once valid IP saved; disables IPv6 for the zone (backend)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ip_validation.py::test_autowire_succeeds_once_valid_ip_saved_and_disables_ipv6
checks.evidence: PUT settings {server_ip:'203.161.57.207'} -> 200; POST autowire {domain:'sultan5.com'} -> 200 with records sultan5.com and www.sultan5.com both content=203.161.57.207, proxied=true; follow-up GET /api/cloudflare/zones/e2933ef25eec2b393f57c2af845376e4/ssl -> ipv6:false.

checks.criterion: SSL/IPv6 panel toggles work; sultan5.com restored to ssl=flexible, ipv6=false (backend)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ip_validation.py::test_ssl_ipv6_panel_toggle_roundtrip
checks.evidence: GET ssl -> includes ssl/always_use_https/ipv6 fields; PUT {ipv6:true} -> 200 ipv6:true (confirmed via GET); PUT {ipv6:false} -> 200 ipv6:false; final restore PUT {ssl:'flexible', ipv6:false} confirmed via GET -> {ssl:'flexible', ipv6:false}.

checks.criterion: Cache purge still succeeds after the fix (backend)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ip_validation.py::test_purge_cache_still_succeeds

checks.criterion: Panel warns about missing/invalid IP in the UI (browser)
checks.name: cloudflare-ip-validation-hints
checks.evidence: Logged in admin/admin123, /admin/cloudflare: typing 'benim-sunucum' into cf-server-ip-input shows cf-ip-invalid-hint (red, 'Geçerli bir IPv4 adresi girin'); clearing the field captured; saving '203.161.57.207' via cf-save-ip-button -> PUT /api/cloudflare/settings 200 and cf-current-ip updates to show 'Kayıtlı IP: 203.161.57.207'.

checks.criterion: Cache purge panel unaffected in the UI (browser)
checks.name: cloudflare-purge-cache-actionable-toast
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: purge-cache XHR returns 200 {ok:true}; sonner toast 'Cloudflare önbelleği boşaltıldı' shown.

checks.criterion: Admin login + Cloudflare page renders zones + Domain Doğrulama without crash (browser)
checks.name: cloudflare-panel-renders-live-data
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: admin/admin123 login works; /admin/cloudflare shows 'Bağlı' status, live zone list, Domain Doğrulama rows, SSL & Önbellek widgets, no crash.

notes: Backend probe (curl localhost:8001/api) returned 200 before testing began; full pytest suite: 30 passed (5 new + 25 pre-existing unchanged).

New file test_tscheck_ip_validation.py added with 5 tests covering all 5 backend-bearing briefing criteria: invalid-IP rejection message, empty-IP autowire actionable error, valid-IP autowire success + IPv6-disable side effect, SSL/IPv6 toggle round-trip, and purge-cache regression.

The bug-fix code (valid_ipv4() checks in routers/cloudflare.py PUT /settings and POST /autowire) and the UI hints (cf-ip-invalid-hint, cf-ip-missing-warning, cf-current-ip data-testids in AdminCloudflare.tsx) were already present in the codebase when this retest began -- verified by reading the source and by the new tests all passing on first run, no code changes were needed or made by the testing agent.
New browser check cloudflare-ip-validation-hints added and passed: red inline hint for non-IPv4 input, and successful save+display of the correct IPv4.

Did not separately assert the amber 'no IP saved' warning (cf-ip-missing-warning) via UI because the global server_ip setting was populated for most of the run (shared state across concurrent backend test runs); its presence/logic is exercised indirectly by the backend test test_autowire_with_empty_server_ip_gives_actionable_400 which proves the same underlying condition (empty server_ip) drives the actionable-error code path the warning text mirrors. Screenshot 'empty-input-state' captured the panel while the input was cleared for visual reference.
2 pre-existing browser checks re-run by name only (cloudflare-purge-cache-actionable-toast, cloudflare-panel-renders-live-data) per retest-mode instructions -- both passed unchanged.

Final state verified via standalone curl after the full run: GET /api/cloudflare/status -> server_ip='203.161.57.207'; GET /api/cloudflare/zones/e2933ef25eec2b393f57c2af845376e4/ssl -> {ssl:'flexible', ipv6:false} -- matches spec_deviations restoration requirement exactly.
marcopanel.site was never targeted by any test or check in this iteration; all DNS/SSL/IPv6 writes were scoped to sultan5.com only.

Console noise carried over from prior iterations (unchanged by this iteration): a React 'duplicate key sultan5.com' warning on the Cloudflare panel from accumulated tscheck-autowire-* DNS record fixture residue in Cloudflare itself (own test-fixture namespace, not seeded/production data) -- pre-existing per iteration_4 notes, does not break rendering, out of scope for this iteration's criteria.

6/6 briefing acceptance criteria exercised (within the 8-criterion cap); the 2 UI-surfaced criteria (IP warnings, purge/panel-unaffected) each got a dedicated browser artifact in addition to backend coverage where an API contract also existed.
